verification.aggregate_arithmetic: 27,146 structural/arithmetic checks recomputed the shared finite scale, utility scale/discrepancy, node/edge denominators, all normalized energies/contrasts, gauge and projection identities, graph masses and original all-cell summaries from saved JSON. No inconsistency was found within the fixed float64 rounding allowance. All 16 summary min/max values and defined/undefined counts match exactly; independent math.fsum means differ by at most 2.7755575615628914e-17.
verification.denominators: All readouts share their cell's s_F^2=0.001^2+||X_F||^2/(n*4), n*4*s_F^2 and omega*4*s_F^2. Both signs and both centerings use the same graph/scale. Edge masses, same/cross-target edge counts and isolates match the admitted aggregate census in every cell. All edge and contrast denominators are positive in this actual result; there are no undefined ratios, zero-energy ties or omitted cells.
verification.weights: Episode-invariant weights are [1/6,1/6,1/4,1/4,1/7,1/6,1/6,1/6,1/5,1/4] in lexicographic pair order. They are internally consistent with 1/(1+d_max), with implied degrees [5,5,3,3,6,5,5,5,4,3]. Actual maximum degrees were not independently rederived from raw adjacency; source review establishes the recipe, and aggregate census confirms the recorded support counts.

residuals.limit: Gauge/projection residual expressions were recomputed from aggregate scalars. Field norms and row/column centering residuals themselves remain producer-reported, because raw fields were not redecoded. Member-only column offsets are retained confounds, not centering errors.

descriptive_geometry.contrast_definition: C=(Gt-G0)/(Gt+G0); negative means lower signed proxy energy. Mean C is an equal-cell mean of ratios, not a prediction gain or a percentage reduction relative to unsigned energy.
descriptive_geometry.mixed_and_opposite_results_retained: The pooled mean favors signed proxy energy and remains negative after mass projection in both banks. The observation is not uniform: pair (3,4) favors unsigned energy in episodes 7-16 in every readout, and its tangent mean C is +0.05428320141575516 for F and +0.04084582491980413 for U. The other nine pair means are negative. All 28 cells with any unsigned-favoring readout remain in the recomputation backing file.
descriptive_geometry.offset_confound_check: F projection changes six cells from unsigned-lower to signed-lower. U changes five toward signed-lower and one toward unsigned-lower. Removing member-column offsets makes the pooled mean more negative, so those offsets do not create the pooled signed preference. They affect individual orientations and do not remove unknown member-varying susceptibility weights.
descriptive_geometry.interpretation_limits: These are finite softplus-loss-response and first-order private-gradient cost proxies from one utility trajectory. They do not identify actual canonical-logit changes or susceptibility; establish prediction quality, served benefit, optimized-Q equivalence, causality or novelty; choose an orientation/prior/graph/coefficient; or authorize a new gate/fit. Pair memberships and consecutive episodes overlap, so counts and means are descriptive, with no independence test. The induced graph's 58.82%-82.34% isolates dilute node-normalized energy; edge-normalized values are retained. Target signs do not change graph support or connectivity.

receipt_and_timing.internal_timer_scope: Begins immediately before joint-B decode and graph reconstruction; includes bank load, analysis and post-analysis custody check, ending during result construction. Excludes earlier admission/imports and final JSON publication.
receipt_and_timing.whole_child_timer_scope: Wrapper monotonic interval around the CPU reader subprocess, including interpreter startup, admission/imports, calculation and publication; fixed child timeout 120 seconds.
receipt_and_timing.transport_timer_scope: Local receipt start/terminal UTC interval around the SSH request, staging/route checks, child and aggregate transfer. It is not the algorithm or whole-child time.
receipt_and_timing.warnings: Child stderr contains a TypedStorage deprecation warning; exit code is zero and the returned aggregate hash/bytes match. Transport stderr contains the standard SSH key-exchange warning. Neither is a numerical failure in this receipt.
